data.dashboards.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
- disableDeletion: false
  editable: true
  folder: Karta
  name: Karta
  options:
    path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
  orgId: 1
  type: file
data.datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
- access: proxy
  editable: false
  isDefault: true
  jsonData:
    httpMethod: POST
    timeInterval: 30s
  name: Karta Prometheus
  type: prometheus
  uid: karta-prometheus
  url: http://karta-prometheus:9090/karta/prometheus

rules.expr:
max by (namespace, pod, pod_uid, workload, workload_group, workload_version, workload_kind,
        workload_uid, owner_resolution, component, component_instance, replica_group_id) (
  karta_pod_workload_info
)
and on (namespace, pod)
(count by (namespace, pod) (
  group by (namespace, pod, pod_uid, workload, workload_group, workload_version, workload_kind,
            workload_uid, owner_resolution, component, component_instance, replica_group_id) (
    karta_pod_workload_info
  )
) == 1)
